## What
Create `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-vs-local-parity-scope.md` documenting the dispatch-architecture delta between CI and local /dso:review.

## Content to include

### CI vs Local Dispatch Architecture
| Review tier | Local /dso:review | CI litellm |
|-------------|-------------------|------------|
| light | 1 Agent call (light agent) | 1 litellm call |
| standard | 1 Agent call (standard agent) | 1 litellm call |
| deep | 3 Agent calls parallel (specialists) + 1 Agent call (arch) | 3 litellm calls parallel + 1 litellm call (arch synthesis) |

### Parity Scope
- **In scope**: All tier and overlay reviewer .md prompts are used identically in both local and CI paths (single source of truth)
- **Out of scope / approximation delta**: Local uses Claude Code Agent tool for each specialist (full conversational capability, file access); CI uses litellm direct completion (stateless single-call)

### Fidelity Tolerance Acceptance Criterion
- CI deep-tier verdict must be within one severity band of local on fixture PRs
- Acceptable divergence: a finding rated 'important' locally may be 'critical' or 'style' in CI; a 'critical' local finding must remain at least 'important' in CI
- If fixture divergence exceeds this tolerance, the CI deep-tier path is rolled back to standard tier pending investigation
